items.name: Fix 'Open as new file session' context menu action
items.description: Right-clicking a file and selecting 'open as new file session' does nothing. It should open a new File Session.

items.name: Add inline todo creation with '+' button
items.description: In the TODO tab in the right pane, add a '+ todo item' input that always appears below the unchecked todo items, allowing inline creation of new todo items.

items.name: Fix Claude Usage tracking not starting automatically
items.description: In the Status tab, Claude Usage gets stuck showing 'Run claude to activate usage tracking'. It should start tracking anytime there is a claude session and the tab is active.

items.name: Add Codex Usage tracking to Status tab
items.description: Add a Codex Usage tracking section to the Status tab in the right pane, styled identically to the Claude Usage tracker.

items.name: Fix file deletion ignoring confirmation dialog
items.description: Right-click 'Delete file' deletes the file immediately regardless of whether OK or Cancel is pressed in the confirmation popup. File should only be deleted when OK is pressed; Cancel should be a no-op.

items.name: Add drag-and-drop file moving into subfolders
items.description: Allow dragging files in the file tab to move them into subfolders. If a file is dragged but not dropped onto a subfolder, it should be a no-op and not change the file order.

items.name: Fix tab header padding inconsistency
items.description: The Processes tab header text has no right-side padding, ending right at the pane edge. Add consistent padding on both sides of all tab headers in the left pane.
